```{r}
# ==============================================================
# RCTD + C-SIDE Test on One Sample (127)
# ==============================================================
# Run this from R/RStudio
# ==============================================================

library(spacexr)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

base_dir   <- "/Users/adiallo/Desktop/Thesis/Data_Documents/All_Data/Visium_samples/Visium_Data/samples"
sample_id  <- "127"

# ==============================================================
# STEP 1: Build RCTD Reference from atlas
# ==============================================================
cat("=== Step 1: Building Reference ===\n")

atlas <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "atlas_data.rds"))

# Extract raw counts — RCTD needs raw counts, not normalized
counts_ref <- GetAssayData(atlas, layer = "counts")

# If counts layer is empty, try slot approach for older Seurat
if (ncol(counts_ref) == 0 || nrow(counts_ref) == 0) {
  counts_ref <- atlas@assays$RNA@counts
}

cat("  Atlas dimensions:", nrow(counts_ref), "genes x", ncol(counts_ref), "cells\n")

# Cell type annotations
cell_types <- as.factor(atlas@meta.data$cl295v11SubFull)
names(cell_types) <- colnames(atlas)

cat("  Cell types:", nlevels(cell_types), "unique types\n")
cat("  Top 10 most common:\n")
print(head(sort(table(cell_types), decreasing = TRUE), 10))

# Create Reference object
# nUMI = total counts per cell (RCTD uses this internally)
nUMI_ref <- colSums(counts_ref)
# Fix cell type names — replace / with _
cell_types <- as.factor(gsub("/", "_", as.character(cell_types)))
names(cell_types) <- colnames(counts_ref)

# Check what was fixed
grep("_", levels(cell_types), value = TRUE)
reference <- Reference(counts_ref, cell_types, nUMI_ref)
cat("  Reference created successfully\n\n")

# Free memory
rm(atlas)
gc()

# ==============================================================
# STEP 2: Load Visium sample 127
# ==============================================================
cat("=== Step 2: Loading Visium sample", sample_id, "===\n")

sce <- readH5AD(file.path(base_dir, paste0(sample_id, ".h5ad")))

# Raw counts
counts_vis <- assay(sce, "X")
if (!inherits(counts_vis, "dgCMatrix")) {
  counts_vis <- as(counts_vis, "dgCMatrix")
}
cat("  Visium dimensions:", nrow(counts_vis), "genes x", ncol(counts_vis), "spots\n")

# Spatial coordinates
coords <- as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce, "spatial"))
colnames(coords) <- c("x", "y")
rownames(coords) <- colnames(sce)
cat("  Coordinates loaded:", nrow(coords), "spots\n")

# nUMI per spot
nUMI_vis <- colSums(counts_vis)

# Create SpatialRNA object
spatial_rna <- SpatialRNA(coords, counts_vis, nUMI_vis)
cat("  SpatialRNA created\n\n")

# ==============================================================
# STEP 3: Run RCTD
# ==============================================================
cat("=== Step 3: Running RCTD ===\n")
cat("  This may take a few minutes...\n")

rctd <- create.RCTD(spatial_rna, reference, max_cores = 4)

# full mode: estimates all cell types per spot (best for Visium with mixed spots)
rctd <- run.RCTD(rctd, doublet_mode = "full")

cat("  RCTD complete\n")

# Inspect results
weights <- rctd@results$weights
cat("  Weight matrix:", nrow(weights), "spots x", ncol(weights), "cell types\n")
cat("  Cell types found:\n")
print(colnames(weights))

# Normalize weights to proportions
weights_norm <- sweep(weights, 1, rowSums(weights), "/")
cat("\n  Mean proportions (top 10):\n")
means <- sort(colMeans(weights_norm), decreasing = TRUE)
print(head(means, 10))

# Save RCTD result
saveRDS(rctd, file.path(base_dir, paste0("rctd_", sample_id, ".rds")))
cat("  Saved to rctd_", sample_id, ".rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================
# STEP 4: Run C-SIDE (single sample test)
# ==============================================================
cat("=== Step 4: Running C-SIDE ===\n")
# Define region covariate from histology
histology <- colData(sce)$histology
if (is.null(histology)) {
  cat("  WARNING: No histology column found. Skipping C-SIDE.\n")
  cat("  You'll need to add region labels manually.\n")
} else {
  # Binary covariate: CT = 1, non-CT = 0
  region_binary <- as.numeric(histology == "cancer_cancer")
  names(region_binary) <- colnames(sce)
  
  cat("  Region covariate: CT =", sum(region_binary == 1), 
      "spots, non-CT =", sum(region_binary == 0), "spots\n")
  
  # Pick cell types to test — start with abundant ones
  cat("\n  Checking cell type representation...\n")
  for (ct in colnames(weights_norm)[1:min(10, ncol(weights_norm))]) {
    n_spots_above_5pct <- sum(weights_norm[, ct] > 0.05)
    cat(sprintf("    %s: %d spots > 5%%\n", ct, n_spots_above_5pct))
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    available_types <- colnames(weights_norm)
    
    # Find types with good representation
    good_types <- c()
    for (ct in available_types) {
      if (sum(weights_norm[, ct] > 0.05) > 100) {
        good_types <- c(good_types, ct)
      }
    }
    cat("\n  Cell types with >100 spots above 5%:", paste(good_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    if (length(good_types) > 0) {
      test_type <- good_types[1]
      cat("  Running C-SIDE on:", test_type, "\n")
      
      # Build design matrix: X is n_barcodes x 1, rows = barcodes, col = covariate
      barcodes_use <- colnames(rctd@spatialRNA@counts)
      X <- matrix(region_binary[barcodes_use], ncol = 1)
      rownames(X) <- barcodes_use
      colnames(X) <- "CT_vs_nonCT"
      
      rctd_cside <- run.CSIDE(
        myRCTD = rctd,
        X = X,
        barcodes = barcodes_use,
        cell_types = test_type,
        cell_type_threshold = 100,
        test_mode = "individual",
        doublet_mode = TRUE,
        fdr = 0.05
      )
      
      cat("  C-SIDE complete!\n")
      
      # Extract DE results
      de_results <- rctd_cside@de_results$res_gene_list
      cat("  DE results for", test_type, ":\n")
      if (length(de_results) > 0) {
        for (ct_name in names(de_results)) {
          sig_genes <- de_results[[ct_name]]
          n_sig <- nrow(sig_genes)
          cat(sprintf("    %s: %d significant genes\n", ct_name, n_sig))
          if (n_sig > 0) {
            print(head(sig_genes, 10))
          }
        }
      }
      
      saveRDS(rctd_cside, file.path(base_dir, paste0("cside_test_", sample_id, ".rds")))
      cat("  Saved C-SIDE results\n")
    } else {
      cat("  No cell types with enough representation. Try lowering the threshold.\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  C-SIDE error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    cat("  This is expected for a first run — we may need to adjust parameters.\n")
  })
}

cat("\n=== Done ===\n")
cat("If RCTD worked (Step 3), the deconvolution is feasible.\n")
cat("If C-SIDE worked (Step 4), cell-type-specific DE on spatial data is feasible.\n")
cat("Next step: scale to all 41 samples with multi-sample meta-regression.\n")
```
